valid/collection-lists.json.rule: collection lists of every layout, one entry and twenty-four, the most; no collection chosen yet; every order, by when an entry went live, by title and by a field's key, both ways; a filter by a toggle, on and off, and by a choice's option of 60 characters, in code points too; a card with no field of its own, and one with an image, a day and an excerpt; no words at a card's foot, and 40; an empty list's words of 200; two columns and four; a colour of the site's own, a slot's on tablets, hidden on phones

valid/columns-one-to-four.json.rule: sections with one, two, three and four columns, and an empty column

valid/columns-stack-every-value.json.rule: where columns stack, on two, three and four columns: on phones only, or never; with a preset, fit ones included, and without

valid/columns-widths-every-preset.json.rule: every column-width preset, each on a section with as many columns as it has parts, fit ones included

valid/every-icon-and-provider.json.rule: every icon name, both video providers, map extremes

valid/fields.json.rule: the entry's title and a field by its key, a text drawn as a heading of every level and as a paragraph; every setting a field drawn as a heading, a text, an image or a button takes, free type included, on every device; a key of 64 characters

valid/form-fields-every-kind.json.rule: every kind of field, required and not; a line of text limited to 1 and to 300 characters, a longer text to 5000; names of one letter and of 40 characters, with digits and hyphens; twenty fields, the most a form holds; and a second form using the same names, since names are unique in a form, not on the page

valid/free-type-every-key.json.rule: a heading's, a text's and a quote's own type, beside a step and a typeface: every key on every device; each unit of a size at both ends of its range, with two decimals, one and none; every weight; letter spacing, line height and letter width at both ends of their ranges, negative, zero and fractional

valid/free-type-integral-floats.json.rule: free type written 700.0, 1e2, 2.00 and -0.0 is the weight 700, the width 100, the line height 2 and the spacing 0 to both engines, after the rules make them integers

valid/header-sticky.json.rule: the site's header may stay at the top of the window: sticky is true, or absent

valid/heading-link.json.rule: a heading may carry a link, as in the approved mock

valid/hrefs-every-form.json.rule: every link form the href pattern allows

valid/ids-edge.json.rule: ids: 64 characters, digits only, underscores and hyphens

valid/image-crop-every-aspect.json.rule: every crop an image may take, in base and in both overrides, original included as an override back to the image's own shape

valid/image-sources.json.rule: library image, external https image, site path, decorative image without alt

valid/integral-floats.json.rule: 2.0, 45.0, 1.2e1 and 3.000 are integers to both engines, and -0.0 and 1e-400 are 0; the rules turn them into integers, so Ruby renders <h2>, not <h2.0>

valid/landing.json.rule: the base page: every widget type, style overrides on every device; each invalid file changes one thing in it

valid/large-500-blocks.json.rule: exactly 500 blocks: 20 sections of 4 columns of 5 widgets

valid/logo-and-menu.json.rule: a logo with and without a name, and menus: one link, twelve (the most), every link form, labels and names at their 40 characters, in code points too

valid/minimal.json.rule: the smallest document: no description, no sections

valid/nesting-at-limit.json.rule: rich text with 12 nested lists: exactly 64 levels of JSON nesting, the most the rules allow

valid/pricing-plans.json.rule: a pricing block of one plan, the fewest, and one of four, the most; a name of one character and of 80, a price of 24 characters, in code points too, a period of 40 and an empty one, a text of 400 that breaks its lines, with an empty line, and an empty text; no features and twelve of 120 characters, in code points too; a badge of 30 on a featured plan, none on another, and one kept on a plan that is not featured; a button's link in every form a button's link takes; a colour of the site's own, a slot's on tablets, hidden on phones

valid/readme-example.json.rule: the example in schema/README.md, checked by the lint

valid/rich-text-every-mark-once.json.rule: all three marks on one text node and on one line break, in two orders: each type at most once is the rule, not a fixed order

valid/rich-text.json.rule: the rich-text subset: nested lists three deep, every mark, hard break with marks, empty paragraph, numbered list attrs

valid/section-anchors-apart-from-ids.jso.rule: an anchor may be another block's id, since only anchors become ids on the page; sections without one never clash

valid/section-space-every-step.json.rule: every value of spaceAbove and spaceBelow, spacing steps and section steps, in base and in both overrides

valid/stats-figures.json.rule: a stats block of one figure and one of eight, the most it holds; a value of one character and of 24, in code points too, a label of one character and of 80; values written with signs and units as they are shown; a colour of the site's own and a figure's words aligned per device

valid/steps-two-and-ten.json.rule: a steps block of two steps, the fewest, and one of ten, the most; a title of one character and of 120, in code points too; a text of one character and of 1000, its line breaks kept, an empty line too; a colour of the site's own, a slot's on tablets, hidden on phones

valid/string-escapes.json.rule: JSON escapes: quote, backslash, slash, a letter and an accented letter as u-escapes, an emoji as a surrogate pair of two escapes, and the member name type spelled with an escaped t

valid/styles-every-token.json.rule: every style key and token value, with tablet and phone overrides

valid/text-inner-nbsp.json.rule: a no-break space inside text with visible letters is fine; only all-blank text is refused

valid/text-length-combining-at-max.json.rule: 100 times e + U+0301: 200 code points, 100 visible letters, maxLength 200

valid/text-length-emoji-at-max.json.rule: 200 emoji in a heading: 200 code points (400 UTF-16 units), maxLength 200

valid/unicode-text.json.rule: non-ASCII text in every plain-text field and in rich text
